description: A laurel-crowned, heavy-set older man in red cloak and segmented armour stands barefoot-sandalled on a large bronze shield, held aloft by cheering helmeted legionaries. Behind them are tents, campfires, smoke-darkened sky, and tall gold eagle standards and a round-disc standard. The painted style is an oil-painting look; no text is visible, and the image fills its frame edge to edge.
